strings.(메디아가 환한 미소를 지으며 반갑게 맞이한다.): (Medea greets the adventurer warmly with a radiant smile.)
strings.(저 분이 저렇게 반가워하는 모습을 보여주는 사람이었나?): (Has she ever looked this happy to see someone?)
strings.왜 그렇게 멍하니 있어요? 볼 일이 있는 게 아니었나요?: Why are you standing there blankly? Didn't you have business here?
Oh, yes... I came to thank you for helping Minuet.
strings.후훗, 뭘요. 별거 아닌 일이랍니다. 자, 차라도 한잔하면서 다른 이야길: Hehe, it was nothing. Come, let's have some tea and talk of other things.
You know the name of this tea.
Yes. When you gave me some before...
Oh, so I told you. Here you are.
What an interesting person. Go on, drink.
strings.(평소와는 다른 느낌이야, 설마 메디아 님이 아니라던가….): (Something feels different. Could she be someone other than Medea...?)
strings.(그러고 보니 칼리의 분위기가 이상해.): (Come to think of it, something feels wrong about Kali.)
You haven't touched your tea. I thought you might suspect.
strings.메디아 님이 아니군요. 당신…. 분명 말투를 비슷하게 따라 한 것 같지만: You're not Medea. You... Your manner of speaking is similar, but...
strings.(메디아의 모습이 천천히 환영처럼 사라져간다.): (Medea's form slowly fades like an illusion.)
strings.제가 사랑하는 메디아는 잠깐 자리를 비웠습니다. 저는 그 아이가 이룬 우: My beloved Medea is away for a moment. I only came to see the village she built for our people. I have no other intention.
strings.게다가 당신이 그 아이를 얼마나 신뢰하는지도 잘 알았습니다. 그 아이의: And now I know how deeply you trust her. I felt her trust in you as well.
Perhaps I am the person you think I am.
strings.그럼 나중에 만나요. 당신에게 일이 너무 많다는 게 유감이지만…. 바이스: Until next time. It's unfortunate that you have so much to do... What Weiss intends will be more than enough to occupy you.
strings.아, 지스크 영지의 호숫가에 당신에게 주려고 '환영의 눈물'을 숨겨뒀어요: Oh, I hid "Illusion's Tears" for you by the lake at Zisk's Estate. Go find them... If you want to know their use, ask the tempting demon...
strings.(여성의 목소리가 사라지자 칼리를 가득 채운 기묘한 분위기 또한 원래대로: (As the woman's voice fades, the strange atmosphere filling Kali returns to normal.)
strings.(지스크 영지의 호숫가, 그리고 유혹하는 악마면 벨레드….): (The lake at Zisk's Estate, and the tempting demon... Veled...)
At this point, I need to know...
What she's trying to tell me...
Welcome, %s. I was just looking for you. There's something I wanted to discuss.
strings.저도 이야기할 게 있어서 왔어요. 그런데 절 찾았다고요?: I came to talk too. But you were looking for me?
Yes. Not about my beauty, though.
I know you lack aesthetic sensibility, so there's no need to apologize. Peonia told me to compliment you next time we met.
strings.아하하하…. 그래서 하고 싶은 이야기가 뭐에요?: Ahahaha... So what did you want to say?
No, you first. You didn't come for nothing.
Oh, take this. Someone told me to bring it to you.
strings.(벨레드가 환영의 눈물을 받아들고 빤히 본다.): (Veled takes the Illusion's Tears and studies them.)
strings.나 얼마 전에 주인이었던 존재의 꿈을 꿨거든. 아스모데아…, 그가 이걸: I recently dreamed of the being who was my master. Asmodea... He was holding this. He was delighted, saying the Illusion's Tears would make his wish come true sooner.
strings.벨레드와 아스모데아의 공통된 기억인가요?: Is it a memory shared by you and Asmodea?
I don't know. Whether it's a real memory or an illusion-like dream...
strings.아스모데아는 사라졌어. 로젠가르텐으로 가는 통로였던 우물엔 아무것도 느껴: Asmodea has vanished. I sense nothing in the well that led to Rosengarten. That's why I need to know.
strings.쫓겨난 건지, 놀러나온 건지, 아니면 스스로 여기에 오게 된 건지…. 하: Was I cast out? Did I come out to play? Or did I choose to come here...? I don't know any of it.
strings.정리되지 않은 기억과 마석으로 만들어진 존재인 나. 어쩌면 이게 실마리가: I'm a being made from jumbled memories and a magic stone. Perhaps this could be a clue.
The person who told me to find it said you'd know if I brought it to you.
strings.네. 그렇게 하라고 벨레드에게 온 거니까요. 그런데 이걸 어떻게 사용하죠: Yes. That's why I brought it to you. But how do you use it? Oh, Veled?
strings.(벨레드가 장미 펜던트에다 환영의 눈물을 가져다 댄다. 그러자 보라색 빛: (Veled holds the Illusion's Tears against his rose pendant. Violet light begins circling him.)
...This was made from one of Weiss's magic stones too. Like me... They're resonating... I think I understand a little...
I wanted to see more, but that must have been the limit. It's gone. Sorry.
strings.뭔가 알아냈어요? 말해줄 수 있어요?: Did you learn something? Can you tell me?
strings.조금 애매해도 이야기해줄게. 바이스가 가지고 있던 마석은 보통 마석이 아: It's a little unclear, but I'll explain. Weiss's magic stones are no ordinary stones. He extracts magic from living beings, refines it, places it inside, and adds souls.
strings.그 영혼은 몽마들이 가지고 있던 게 아닌 마녀들이 멋대로 만들어 집어넣은: Those souls didn't belong to the incubi. Witches created and inserted them as they pleased. That's why my memories are such a mess.
strings.나, 마녀가 영혼을 집어넣은 마석과 아스모데아의 힘이 뒤섞여 만들어진 인: I'm a doll made from Asmodea's power mixed with a magic stone into which a witch placed a soul.
strings.예정대로면 깨어나 아스모데아의 부족한 영혼을 채우고 버려졌겠지. 하지만: As planned, I should have awakened, filled the gaps in Asmodea's soul, and been discarded. But a witch played a trick, and I was lucky enough to survive.
Normally, both Asmodea and Weiss would notice a trick like that...
Thank you. It helped. That's everything I learned.
strings.너 뭔가 아쉬운 표정이야. 네가 알고 싶은 게 없어서 어쩌지. 대신 아름: You look disappointed. Sorry there wasn't anything you wanted to know. Shall I tell you about beauty instead?
No need to be shy, but Peonia told me not to do that, so I won't.
The one who hid this must be a witch. Deliberately provoking you like that...
strings.그 마녀가 나를 통해 너에게 메시지를 전달했어. 똑같은 걸 구해서 자기가: She sent you a message through me. Find another one of these and give it to the child she loves.
Apparently, you'll need another Illusion's Tears.
strings.…아마도 같은 곳에 하나 더 숨겨놓았나봐요. 고마워요, 벨레드. 그럼 가: ...She probably hid another in the same place. Thank you, Veled. I'll be going.
strings.아앗, 벌써 갔네. %s의 영혼에 관한 걸 이야기하려고 했는데…. 이야기: Oh, already gone. I was going to talk about %s's soul... Is it all right not to mention it?
I'd better retrieve the tent that blew away first...
It's you. I said I would call you myself, yet you came anyway.
Thank goodness. It really is you, Medea.
When have I ever been anyone else...?
strings.가지고 있는 것을 제게 주시지요. 그리고…: Give me what you're carrying. And...
To give it to the child she loves.
strings.(메디아가 환영의 눈물을 받아 조심스레 손에 쥔다. 잠시 후, 메디아가: (Medea carefully holds the Illusion's Tears. When she whispers in an unknown language, they spread like droplets, circle her, and disappear.)
strings.…정말 알다가도 모를 분입니다. 그분은…. 뭘 생각하고 있는지도 모르겠: ...She truly is impossible to understand. I never know what she's thinking...
I'm sorry you encountered her while I was away...
strings.아니에요. 그저 전 미뉴에트를 도와주셔서 감사 인사를 드리려고 했던 것뿐: It's all right. I only came to thank you for helping Minuet...
strings.궁금한 게 있을텐데 물어보시지 않으시나요?: Surely you have questions. Aren't you going to ask?
I believe you're trying to find a way.
strings.(메디아가 짐짓 놀라지만, 이내 평온한 표정으로 돌아간다.): (Medea looks briefly surprised, then regains her composure.)
I'm only sorry that the time isn't now.
strings.살짝 궁금한데, 제 신뢰의 크기는 어느 정도가 됐나요?: I'm a little curious. How much trust have I earned now?
strings.가시는 길에 샤이닉에게 저는 잘 있다고 안부 전해주세요. 그리고 저에 대: On your way, please tell Shynic I'm well. And there's no need to worry too much about me.
strings.(대답을 피하시네. 어쩔 수 없지.): (She's avoiding the question. Can't be helped.)
Understood. I'll give Shynic your regards. See you next time.
strings.(타르타로스는 예정에 없었는데, 한번 가볼까….): (Tartarus wasn't in my plans, but shall I visit...?)
...Your goddess will be all right too. Travel safely...
strings.제 선택이 많이 늦어서 그분께서 나타나신 것 같군요. 저도 좀 더 자리를: I seem to have delayed my choice so long that she appeared herself. I will be away for longer as well.
strings.그래서 결계를 좀 더 강화하려고 합니다. 괜찮겠죠?: So I intend to strengthen the barrier. Is that all right?
Of course. We trust you, Medea.
Thank you, Beinan. I'll make the preparations.
strings.(이제 그가 매서운 눈보라를 헤치면 돼….): (Now they only need to brave the fierce blizzard...)
Your power definitely feels different. The goddess's blessing is stronger.
I don't know the details, but...
Hmm... Sniff, sniff... The smell is weaker too.
What on earth do I smell like...?
Boredom. ♡ You know that by now.
Of course. I'm a dull human...
Oh, Medea asked me to give you her regards.
You've been to Kali? All right.
What were you doing? It doesn't look very entertaining.
People can't spend their whole lives only doing fun things.
That sounds strange coming from you...
strings.바로 재미없는 일 만들어 줄 수 있는데, 보여줄까?♡: I could make something very unfun happen right now. Want to see? ♡
strings.(샤이닉이 반짝거리는 데스사이드를 앞으로 내민다.): (Shynic thrusts her gleaming Death Scythe forward.)
All right. ♡ It's nothing much. I'm thinking of releasing some magic I sealed away.
I had no use for it, so I sealed it.
strings.당장은 아니고, 뭐 언젠가? 신경 쓰지 마♡: Not right now. Someday, perhaps? Don't worry about it. ♡
strings.(봉인된 힘이라니…. 뭔가 무서운데 신경쓰지 말라니…. 장난으로 하는 말: (Sealed power...? That's frightening, yet she says not to worry. Is she joking? I can't tell...)
strings.오늘 저녁은 멜빅이 프리링 카레 만들었으니 먹고 가. 프리링은 안들었으니: Melvic made Priring curry for dinner. Stay and eat. Don't worry, there aren't any Prirings in it!
Thank you, Shynic. I'm hungry, so I'd be glad to.
strings.나는 조금 이따가 갈 테니까 멜빅한테 먼저 가 있어. 알았지? 아, 접시: I'll come in a little while. Go to Melvic first, all right? Oh, ask him to draw a Priring on my plate. ♡
strings.슬슬 배고프네, 정리만 하고 갈까?: I'm getting hungry. Just finish tidying up, then go?
Humans really are interesting. Even when we feel awful...
Even when we're suffering, we get hungry.
strings.(이제 %s에게 남은 건 이오와 메디아의 힘인 건가?): (So all %s needs now is Io's power and Medea's?)
